name: Mystic Metamagic (Ki)
body:
Your ki fuels your magical manipulations.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation, at least one metamagic feat

Benefit(s): As a swift action, you can spend 1 or more points from your ki pool, up to a maximum equal to your Wisdom bonus, to prepare (or cast, if a spontaneous caster) a metamagic spell without increasing the level of the spell slot required. This requires a number of ki points equal to the level adjustment of the metamagic feat (minimum 1). The total adjusted level of the spell, including all metamagic feats applied to it, may not exceed the highest level of spells you are able to cast. This feat can offset the level adjustment of only one metamagic feat, and any spell prepared or cast with this feat cannot be further adjusted by other metamagic feats.
